changelog: 🚀 Single Unified JIN APK (jin-termux-v2.1.5): Complete production release combining JIN-Termux, PRoot rootfs, 100 PC Power Tools, Real-Time Voice, and Mobile-Harness Studio.

🛡️ Universal Bootstrap & Agent Vault: Persistent Agent Vault safeguards Antigravity (agy), Claude Code, and IDE Bridge across custom bootstrap ZIP uploads (both heavy full rootfs and ultra-light BusyBox/Alpine micro-environments).

⚡ Seamless Rootfs Compatibility: Automatic agent binary restoration, shell fallback symlinking (bash -> sh/ash), dynamic PRoot path bindings (/antigem/bin), and self-healing engine downloads guarantee 100% agent execution reliability on any uploaded bootstrap.
🛠️ 100 PC Tools Hub: Smooth horizontal scrolling category pills row, completely eliminating vertical letter-wrapping. Exactly 100 features verified across 10 categories.
🤖 Harness Studio Revamped: Interactive Provider Selection Modal (OpenCode Zen, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Claude, Kimi, NVIDIA NIM, Custom) and Model Search & Preset Picker Dialog.
📦 Unlimited GB Zero-Memory File Streaming: Added StreamingFileUtils utilizing 64KB NIO chunk buffers directly to disk; uploads of any size process without OOM heap crashes.
🔑 AI Provider Credentials Manager: Secure on-device AES API key vault in Harness Studio Runtimes & Engines tab to save and test keys for all providers.
